turns.sentence: Good morning! How was your weekend?
It was great, thanks. How about yours?
Pretty relaxing. I mostly stayed home.
Sounds nice. Ready for the meeting later?
Do you have a minute? I'm stuck on this spreadsheet formula.
Sure, let me take a look. What are you trying to calculate?
I need the total sales per region, but it keeps returning an error.
Ah, I see the issue — you're missing a closing bracket right here.
Of course, I completely missed that. Thanks for catching it.
I get the sense our manager is favoring one team's proposal over ours, even though the numbers are comparable.
I've noticed that too, though I think it's more about visibility than merit — they've simply presented more often.
That's a fair point. Maybe we should request more face time to walk through our approach directly.
Agreed — let's frame it as an update rather than a pitch, so it doesn't come across as competitive.
Smart approach. I'll set up some time with them this week.
